title: Nissan Chemical
summary: Japanese chemical maker supplying resist underlayers, CMP materials and display chemicals.
bodyHtml:
Investment Thesis

Nissan Chemical produces anti-reflective coatings, resist underlayers, CMP slurries and specialty chemicals for semiconductor and display manufacturing. These materials are less visible than photoresists but sit in every advanced patterning flow, and qualification is sticky once established. Agrochemicals and pharmaceuticals add balance.

Technology Exposure

  • Anti-reflective coatings and resist underlayers
  • CMP slurries and specialty chemicals
  • Agrochemicals and pharmaceuticals

What To Watch

  • Advanced patterning adoption
  • Display materials demand
  • Agrochemical pricing

Record Notes

Editorial brief compiled 19 November 2026 from company disclosures, agency publications and press reporting. Figures are as reported by those sources and have not been independently audited; no live market data is used.
